intro:
Above-the-line (ATL) advertising builds broad awareness through mass media, while through-the-line (TTL) campaigns combine that reach with targeted digital activity that drives action. Used together, they put your brand in front of large audiences and turn attention into measurable results.

Eire Tech plans, creates and manages ATL and TTL campaigns from the first idea to the final report. We align every channel behind one creative concept and one set of goals, so your traditional and digital advertising reinforce each other.

Outdoor advertising and print advertising keep your brand visible in the real world. We design and place billboards, transit and street furniture ads, digital out-of-home screens, newspaper and magazine adverts, flyers and brochures, making sure every format is bold, legible and on-brand.

Integrated multi-channel campaigns connect offline and online media under one message. A radio or billboard campaign can drive people to search, social and a dedicated landing page, where digital ads, retargeting and email capture and convert that interest.

Strong campaigns come from careful campaign planning. We define objectives and audiences, build the media plan and budget, manage suppliers and timelines, oversee execution and track results with clear KPIs such as reach, frequency, brand lift, website traffic and leads.
benefits: Mass-market reach combined with targeted digital conversion
One creative idea carried consistently across every channel
Media planning and buying focused on value for your budget
End-to-end management of suppliers, production and timelines
Clear post-campaign reporting on reach, response and results
faqs: What is the difference between ATL, BTL and TTL advertising? | ATL (above the line) uses mass media such as TV, radio and outdoor to build awareness. BTL (below the line) targets specific audiences directly, for example through events or direct mail. TTL (through the line) blends both approaches, usually combining mass reach with targeted digital activity.

Is traditional advertising still effective? | Yes, especially for building brand awareness and trust at scale. It is most effective when combined with digital channels that capture and measure the demand it creates, which is exactly what a TTL campaign does.

How do you measure the results of an ATL campaign? | We use reach and frequency data, dedicated URLs and QR codes, promo codes, search and website traffic uplift, call tracking and brand awareness surveys to connect offline activity to real outcomes.

What budget do I need for an ATL or TTL campaign? | Budgets vary widely by market, media and duration. We build a plan around what you want to achieve and what you can invest, and show you the expected reach before any money is committed.

Landing Pages Designed With Conversion in Mind
Conversion Tracking That Goes Beyond Clicks
Paid Advertising Across Ireland, Europe and the USA
Make Every Advertising Budget Work Harder
details:
Google Ads can put your business in front of potential customers at the moment they are actively searching for a product, service or solution.

Getting that visibility is only the beginning.

Our Google Ads management services start with understanding how your customers search and which queries show genuine buying intent. We structure campaigns around relevant keywords, carefully selected match types, negative keywords, locations and audience signals to reduce wasted clicks.

Depending on your business, campaigns can include Google Search Ads, Performance Max, Shopping, Display, YouTube and remarketing.

We continually review search terms, bids, budgets and conversion data. If a keyword is spending money without producing meaningful results, we don't keep it running simply because it generates traffic. The budget should go where it has a better chance of creating business.

Facebook and Instagram advertising allows businesses to reach potential customers based on interests, behaviour and previous interactions with a brand.

Our Meta Ads management combines audience strategy with creative testing. We develop campaigns for lead generation, sales, website conversions, remarketing and brand discovery, depending on what your business actually needs.

Rather than relying on a single ad, we test different messages, visuals, formats and calls to action. Performance data then tells us which combinations deserve more budget and which should be changed.

For eCommerce and service businesses alike, this test-and-learn approach can turn Meta advertising into a scalable acquisition channel rather than a guessing game.

For businesses selling to other businesses, reaching the right job title or company can matter more than reaching the largest possible audience.

LinkedIn Ads can help target decision-makers according to factors such as industry, professional role, company size and seniority.

Eire Tech 360 develops LinkedIn advertising campaigns for B2B lead generation, professional services and other high-value offers. Because LinkedIn clicks can be expensive, targeting and messaging need to be precise. We focus on audience quality and lead value instead of chasing cheap but irrelevant traffic.

Successful pay-per-click advertising starts before an ad is launched.

We research your market, competitors, customer intent and potential search terms to understand where the strongest opportunities exist.

For Google campaigns, that means separating research queries from searches that indicate someone may actually be ready to enquire or buy. For paid social, it means identifying audience groups and messages worth testing.

Campaign structure is then built around those insights rather than assumptions.

A strong advertisement can still underperform if it sends visitors to the wrong page.

That's why our PPC campaign management doesn't stop at the ad platform. We review the experience users receive after clicking and provide landing page recommendations where improvements could increase conversions.

The headline should match the promise made in the ad. The offer needs to be easy to understand. Calls to action should be clear, and unnecessary friction should be removed.

When ads and landing pages work together, businesses have a better opportunity to convert paid traffic into enquiries and sales.

Clicks tell you that someone visited. They don't tell you whether the advertising made money.

We set up and review conversion tracking so campaign decisions can be based on meaningful actions such as enquiries, calls, purchases, bookings or other valuable outcomes.

This allows us to evaluate cost per lead, conversion performance and return on ad spend (ROAS) instead of optimising campaigns around surface-level engagement.

Good tracking also gives us better information for future decisions. We can see which campaigns, audiences, ads and search terms are contributing to results and adjust budgets accordingly.

Paid advertising isn't a launch-it-and-leave-it service.

Markets change. Competitors change their bids. Search behaviour shifts. Creative performance drops over time.

Our team regularly reviews campaign performance and makes informed adjustments to keywords, search terms, audiences, bids, budgets, placements, ads and creative.

We also test new opportunities rather than assuming the first campaign structure will always remain the best one.

The goal is simple: reduce unnecessary spend while finding practical ways to generate more valuable conversions.

Different markets require different approaches.

Customer behaviour, competition, cost per click and messaging can vary significantly between Ireland, European markets and the United States. Eire Tech 360 builds campaigns around the locations your business actually wants to reach rather than applying one generic strategy everywhere.

Whether you're an Irish business targeting local customers, a European company expanding into new markets or a brand looking to grow in the USA, we can develop a paid advertising strategy around your audience, goals and available budget.

You don't need more meaningless clicks. You need advertising that contributes to growth.

Eire Tech 360 combines Google Ads management, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, PPC strategy, conversion tracking and ongoing optimisation to help businesses turn paid traffic into measurable opportunities.

If you're ready to improve an existing campaign or build a paid advertising strategy from the ground up, talk to Eire Tech 360.

Let's turn your advertising budget into leads, customers and measurable business growth.

title: Social Media Marketing
headline: Social Media Marketing That Turns Attention Into Business Growth
desc: Social media has changed. It is no longer simply a place where businesses post a few graphics every week and wait for likes to appear.
intro:
Social media has changed. It is no longer simply a place where businesses post a few graphics every week and wait for likes to appear.

Today, your customers use social platforms to discover businesses, compare products and services, read reviews, ask questions and decide which brands deserve their attention. That means your social presence has to do more than look active. It needs to create trust, start conversations and move the right people closer to becoming customers.

At Eire Tech 360, we build social media marketing strategies around that goal.

We help businesses create a stronger presence across platforms such as Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok and YouTube through audience-focused content, creative campaigns, performance analysis and continuous optimization.
points: Social Media Marketing Built for How People Discover Brands Today
Social SEO: Creating Content People Can Find
Human Content in an AI-Heavy Feed
Social Media Advertising Focused on Performance
Why Choose Eire Tech 360 for Social Media Marketing?
Build a Social Presence People Remember
details:
People don't always begin their search on a traditional search engine anymore.

Someone looking for a service may search Instagram for examples. A potential customer might watch TikTok videos before considering a product. A B2B decision-maker may explore a company's LinkedIn presence before replying to an email or booking a meeting.

This shift has made social media an important part of the modern customer journey.

Our approach connects content creation with discoverability, engagement and conversion. Instead of posting simply to fill a content calendar, we look at what your audience is interested in, the questions they ask and the type of content that can influence their decisions.

The result is a social presence built around business objectives rather than vanity metrics.

Good social media marketing starts long before the first post goes live.

We begin by understanding your business, competitors, customers and goals. From there, we identify suitable platforms, content themes and opportunities that can give your brand a distinctive position.

Not every business needs to be everywhere.

A B2B company may get significantly more value from LinkedIn and thought-leadership content, while a consumer brand may benefit from Instagram Reels, TikTok, creator collaborations and user-generated content.

We focus resources where they have the best chance of producing meaningful results.

Short-form video continues to play a major role across Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts and other social platforms.

But producing more videos isn't automatically a strategy.

The opening seconds need to earn attention. The topic needs to match audience intent. The message needs to be easy to understand, and the call to action needs to make sense within the customer's journey.

We develop video concepts around real business opportunities, including:

Educational tips and quick answers

Product and service demonstrations

Customer problems and solutions

Behind-the-scenes content

FAQs and expert insights

Customer stories and testimonials

Trend-led content relevant to your industry

Rather than chasing every viral trend, we focus on formats that fit your brand and can be repeated consistently.

Social media platforms are increasingly being used as search engines.

This changes how content should be created.

Captions, profile descriptions, video scripts, on-screen text, topics and hashtags can all provide context about what a piece of content is about. Instead of relying on a long list of generic hashtags, we focus on the language your potential customers actually use when searching.

This is where social media marketing and SEO begin to overlap.

For example, instead of publishing a vague post about “growing your business,” a digital marketing company could create content answering a specific query such as:

“How can a small business generate leads through Instagram?”

The second topic has clear intent. It answers a real question and gives the platform more context about who may find the content useful.

That search-first mindset is becoming an important part of modern social media strategy.

AI has made content production faster. It has also made generic content much easier to produce.

That creates a different problem: sameness.

When dozens of brands use similar templates, captions and stock-style visuals, audiences learn to scroll past them.

Our approach is to use technology where it genuinely helps—research, idea development, data analysis and workflow efficiency—while keeping the final communication grounded in human judgment.

Real opinions, genuine customer experiences, original photography, team expertise and natural videos can give audiences something automated content struggles to reproduce: a reason to trust the people behind the brand.

The objective isn't to avoid AI. It is to use it intelligently without allowing your brand to sound like everyone else.

Reach matters, but reaching thousands of people who have no interest in your business has limited value.

We pay attention to deeper signals.

Are people saving the content? Are they sharing it privately? Are relevant prospects visiting the profile? Are customers asking questions? Are conversations moving into DMs? Are those interactions eventually producing enquiries, leads or sales?

These signals tell us much more than likes alone.

We use those insights to continually adjust topics, creative formats, hooks and calls to action.

Customers often trust experiences from other people more than polished advertisements.

That's why user-generated content, customer stories and creator partnerships can be powerful additions to a social media strategy.

Depending on your business, we can build campaigns around reviews, demonstrations, testimonials, customer experiences and creator collaborations.

The emphasis is on relevance rather than follower count alone.

A smaller creator with a highly relevant audience can sometimes be more valuable than a much larger account whose followers have little connection to the product or service being promoted.

Organic content builds familiarity and trust. Paid social can help accelerate reach and put the right offer in front of a more targeted audience.

Eire Tech 360 can combine organic social media marketing with paid campaigns designed around specific objectives, including brand awareness, website traffic, lead generation, remarketing and conversions.

Campaigns are not treated as “set and forget.”

We test audiences, messages, hooks, creatives and offers to identify combinations that perform better. Underperforming campaigns provide data for the next iteration rather than simply consuming more advertising budget.

Some of the best marketing ideas come directly from customers.

Comments, reviews, searches, competitor discussions and frequently asked questions can reveal what people actually care about.

Social listening allows us to identify recurring problems, emerging topics, customer sentiment and content opportunities.

Those insights can influence more than social media. They can help improve website content, advertising campaigns, offers and even the overall customer experience.

Copying the exact same post across every platform may save time, but it often ignores how people behave on each network.

We adapt the core message to the platform.

Instagram may require visually strong Reels and carousels. TikTok often rewards fast, natural storytelling. LinkedIn can work better with expertise, industry observations and professional insights. YouTube provides opportunities for both short-form discovery and deeper educational content.

Your brand identity remains consistent while the presentation changes according to the platform and audience.

A social media report shouldn't be a collection of impressive-looking numbers without context.

We connect reporting to the objective of the campaign.

Depending on your goals, we can monitor reach, engagement quality, video retention, saves, shares, profile activity, website visits, leads, conversion rates and other relevant performance indicators.

More importantly, we use those numbers to answer a practical question:

What should we do differently next month to improve performance?

That turns analytics into action.

You don't need another agency filling your feed with generic posts.

You need a social media strategy that understands your audience, reflects your business and adapts as platforms and customer behaviour change.

Eire Tech 360 combines strategy, content, creative thinking, social SEO, advertising and performance analysis to build social media campaigns around measurable growth.

Whether you want to establish a new social presence, improve an existing one, generate more qualified enquiries or create a stronger connection with your customers, we can build a strategy around your goals.

Your customers are already scrolling, searching, watching and comparing.

The opportunity is to become part of that journey before they choose someone else.

Talk to EireTech360 about your social media marketing goals and let's build a strategy designed to turn attention into meaningful business growth.

intro:
Content should do more than fill a website or keep your social media accounts active. The right content can help people discover your business, understand what you offer, trust your expertise and take the next step.

At Eire Tech 360, we provide content marketing services for businesses across Ireland, Europe and the USA. Our approach combines content strategy, SEO research, audience insights and creative content production to build content around real business goals.

From website copy and SEO articles to social media content and campaign messaging, every piece has a purpose. We focus on creating useful, relevant content that connects with people while supporting search visibility, engagement and conversions.
points: Content Strategy Built Around Your Business Goals
SEO Content Creation That Helps You Get Found
Blog Content That Builds Topical Authority
Content for Social Media and Digital Campaigns
Human-Led Content Supported by Smarter Technology
Content Marketing for Ireland, Europe and the USA
Build a Content Strategy That Supports Growth
details:
Publishing more content isn't always the answer. Publishing the right content is.

Our content strategy services begin with understanding your business, audience, competitors and marketing objectives. We look at what potential customers are searching for, the questions they ask and the information they need at different stages of their journey.

From there, we develop a clear content direction covering topics, formats, channels and publishing priorities.

This helps eliminate random content creation. Instead of asking, “What should we post this week?”, your business has a structured plan built around what your audience actually wants to know.

Search behaviour continues to evolve, but one principle remains important: people search because they want answers.

Our SEO content creation services combine keyword research with search intent and natural writing. Rather than forcing the same keyword into every paragraph, we build content around a primary topic and related terms that help search engines and readers understand the page.

Depending on your strategy, we can create SEO blog articles, landing pages, service pages, website copy, guides, FAQs and other search-focused content.

We also consider headings, internal linking opportunities, page structure and readability so content works as part of your wider SEO strategy.

Your website often shapes a potential customer's first impression of your business.

Visitors should be able to understand what you offer, who it is for and why they should choose you without working through complicated language.

Eire Tech 360 creates website content designed to make that journey easier.

Whether you need new service pages, landing page copy, product content or a complete website content refresh, we focus on clear messaging and logical structure. SEO considerations are built into the process, but we never sacrifice readability simply to fit more keywords onto a page.

Good website content should satisfy search intent and persuade real people at the same time.

A business blog shouldn't exist just because someone said you need one for SEO.

Strategic blog content gives your brand an opportunity to answer customer questions, explore important industry topics and build deeper coverage around the services you provide.

Our blog content writing services focus on topics that have a genuine connection to your audience and business.

We can use keyword research, competitor analysis and content gaps to identify opportunities, then organise related subjects into topic clusters. This creates a more connected content library instead of dozens of unrelated articles competing for attention.

People consume content differently across channels.

A detailed website article may work well in search, but the same message might need a short video script, carousel or concise post on social media.

Our content creation services can support social media campaigns with platform-appropriate concepts, captions, educational posts, promotional messaging and short-form content ideas.

The goal isn't to copy and paste one message everywhere. We adapt the core idea to suit the platform while keeping your brand voice consistent.

This gives businesses a more joined-up approach to website, SEO and social media content.

AI has changed how quickly businesses can research, plan and produce content. Speed, however, doesn't automatically create quality.

Generic content can easily disappear among thousands of similar pages and posts.

At Eire Tech 360, technology can support research, ideation and workflow efficiency, while strategy, context and audience value remain central to the finished content.

We focus on clear explanations, useful insights and brand-specific messaging instead of publishing content simply to increase volume.

That balance helps businesses produce content efficiently without losing the human voice that builds trust.

Consistency becomes easier when everyone knows what needs to be created and why.

We develop content plans and editorial calendars that organise topics around marketing priorities, customer needs, keyword opportunities and campaigns.

A content calendar can define the topic, target audience, channel, content format and publishing schedule before production begins.

For businesses managing multiple channels or markets, this creates structure while still leaving room to respond to new opportunities and changing customer interests.

Content that works in one market won't always connect in exactly the same way somewhere else.

Search behaviour, terminology, customer expectations and competitive landscapes can vary between Ireland, European markets and the United States.

Eire Tech 360 develops content with the target market in mind. Whether your business is building visibility in Ireland, expanding across Europe or targeting customers in the USA, we can align content topics and messaging with the audience you want to reach.

For multi-market campaigns, the objective is to maintain a consistent brand while making the content relevant to each audience.

A content strategy shouldn't remain unchanged simply because it looked good when it was created.

We look at relevant performance signals such as organic visibility, website traffic, engagement, leads and conversions to understand which topics and formats are contributing to your goals.

Existing content can also be refreshed when search behaviour changes, information becomes outdated or new opportunities appear.

This creates an ongoing cycle: research, create, measure and improve.

Great content isn't about publishing the most. It's about creating information that people can find, understand and trust.

Eire Tech 360 combines content strategy, SEO content creation, website content, blog writing and social media content to help businesses build stronger digital visibility across Ireland, Europe and the USA.

Whether you're starting from scratch or need a clearer direction for existing content, we'll help turn your ideas and expertise into content with a defined purpose.

Talk to Eire Tech 360 about a content marketing strategy built around your audience, search visibility and business goals.
